changes: Day-ahead weather forecast inputs (Open-Meteo forecast issued about 24 hours earlier for the hour being predicted: sunlight, cloud, temperature, direct sun) and a second model that predicts how cloudy it will be (clear-sky index) instead of raw sunlight; the two models are averaged.

previous.note: One gradient-boosting model on weather up to now (no forecast inputs).

v2.idea: train on 30 sites instead of the 14 dashboard regions
v2.summary: More sites: no real gain (30.36 vs 30.35 W/m2 with the v1 settings; best deeper, 30 sites 30.04). Not promoted.

v3.idea: add the day-ahead weather forecast for the target hour

result.verdict: NOT PROMOTED: gain on validation too small; keeping v1
result.forecast_source: Open-Meteo Previous Runs API, *_previous_day1 (issued ~24 h earlier), from 2024

v3.summary: Forecast inputs: a small gain (29.64 vs 30.35 W/m2, gain 0.71), below the 1 W/m2 bar. Not promoted alone.

v4.idea: predict the clear-sky index too and average it with the raw model, with forecast inputs
v4.summary: Clear-sky index + averaging: 28.98 vs 30.35 W/m2, gain 1.37 (> 1 W/m2 bar). Promoted.

learning_curve_note: Measured for v1 (weather history only); v4 was not re-run for every size.
data_source: Open-Meteo (ERA5 reanalysis + archived day-ahead forecasts), CC BY 4.0
